messages.subject: AD 2012 conference (Denver, July 2012)
parts:
The last Auto-dif conference was 2008, though
the Europeans have focused workshops every year.


http://www.autodiff.org/ad12/

Full papers: 21 December 2011
Posters: 27 February 2012.
Conf: July 2012


They'll take submissions on frameworks (like
Stan's OO AD) and applications (like Stan itself).

I don't like at all that they use Springer LNCS for
the papers. It's not open access, so I wouldn't
review for it.

I'm also not sure I really want to spend several
days talking about auto-dif. I'd almost certainly
learn something.

- Bob
